name: Self-hosted homelab on K3s
description: Four Ubuntu nodes — three at home, one cloud edge — joined by a WireGuard mesh and running K3s with Calico. Traefik on the edge node is the only public entrypoint; cert-manager issues TLS over Cloudflare DNS-01, Argo CD syncs every workload from git, and secrets are sealed into the repo. It hosts this site, Synapse, Keycloak and the shared Postgres.

name: Sonatype Maven Central Publisher
description: An open-source Gradle plugin I authored and maintain on the official Plugin Portal. It assembles and PGP-signs a JVM artefact bundle and publishes it to Maven Central through Sonatype's Central Portal API, so a release is one Gradle task. Demo projects: github.com/ani2fun/plugin-demo.

name: Synapse
description: An interactive platform for learning data structures, algorithms, system design and languages — prose chapters with rendered diagrams, code blocks you can run and edit in the page, and step-through execution visualisations. A Rust front door (axum + tokio) owns every request and renders pages through an Astro SSR process beside it; the visualiser ships to the browser as a lazy WebAssembly bundle, and submitted solutions are judged in a sandboxed executor. Lessons are Markdown in their own git repos, so publishing a chapter is a push, not a redeploy.

name: Portfolio App
description: You're looking at it. kakde.eu is a fully static Scala portfolio — Scala.js + scalajs-react on the frontend, Tailwind v4 for styling, bundled with Vite. A trivial zio-http server hands over the compiled bundle and a health check, nothing more; the interactive knowledge base it once shipped with grew into Synapse. Packaged as a container and deployed to the homelab K3s cluster by Argo CD.
